measurement: Separate before and after processes, no concurrent build or test. Source bytes loaded once. Each iteration opens a new document and constructs a new renderer before timing Render. Stopwatch and render options allocations are included; opening, renderer construction, hashing, and file I/O are excluded. Allocation counter is GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread. First three iterations are retained in CSV but excluded from medians.
behavior: Zeroed pooled tile frames reduce repeated sample allocations. Buffers return on tile changes and final cleanup, including exceptions. Actual rental sizes count toward the temporary sample limit; an exact allocation is used when predicted pool rounding cannot fit.
limitations: Focused allocation reduction is about 65 percent; render timing difference is too small to establish a speedup. Allocated bytes are not peak or retained process memory. The shared pool can retain returned arrays. No updated paired PDFium throughput, full PDF.js, or cold-start benchmark is claimed.
